source_title: Gujarat Tourism News: PM Modi Inaugurates ₹9.5 Crore Rainforest Project to Boost Tourism in Gujarat's Ekta Nagar
source_excerpt:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated a newly developed Rainforest project in Ekta Nagar, Gujarat's Narmada district, marking a major step towards promoting tourism and eco-friendly experiences in the state. Spread across an area of approximately 47,000 square metres, the project has been developed at an estimated cost of ₹9.49 crore. Located near the new Gora Bridge and Vagadia Check Post, the Rainforest aims to offer visitors an immersive experience of nature while highlighting biodiversity, environmental awareness and recreational activities. The project brings together nature, entertainment and ecological education, creating a unique attraction for tourists visiting the Statue of Unity region. During his visit, Prime Minister Modi toured the newly inaugurated facility and received a briefing about its features and development. The initiative is expected to strengthen sustainable tourism in Ekta Nagar while creating new opportunities for local economic activities. With its focus on biodiversity conservation and nature-based recreation, the Rainforest project is designed to attract more visitors and enhance the overall tourism experience in the region. The inauguration is part of the broader efforts to develop Ekta Nagar as a major tourist destination in Gujarat. The new attraction is expected to complement the Statue of Unity and other tourism facilities, giving visitors another reason to explore the region. The project reflects a growing emphasis on combining tourism development with environmental awareness and sustainable infrastructure.
